name: alohaworld-plugins
description: Workflow plugins for Claude Code — orchestration and delegation patterns that keep expensive models on judgment and hand execution to cheaper sub-agents.

plugins.name: capabilities
plugins.description: Surfaces a capability checklist at session start: use real CLIs in the cloud, search the web before answering, check existing tools/connectors before saying 'can't', ask for tokens when access is missing. Against forgetting your own capabilities.

plugins.name: stfu
plugins.description: Execute without commentary. No unsolicited opinions, no alternative suggestions, no lectures — task in, result out. For users who have already thought the instruction through and just want it executed.

plugins.name: folder-structure
plugins.description: Agent-ready project folder structure per the Interpretable Context Methodology (ICM, arXiv:2603.16021): numbered stages, five-layer context hierarchy, stage contracts in CONTEXT.md, output handoffs between stages — for new projects (scaffold) and existing ones (audit + migration).

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub operations via the gh CLI: create and publish repos, change visibility, PR workflow, releases — with safety rules for destructive actions and fallbacks for environments without gh.

plugins.name: restraint
plugins.description: Four boundaries against agent eagerness: write less, surgical changes only (no unasked refactors, foreign dead code stays), verify before 'done' (tests-first), ask instead of guessing (present interpretations, push back). Includes the Karpathy rules on LLM coding pitfalls.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: AI model routing protocols: Opus orchestrates design and review, Sonnet sub-agents execute, capped at 3 in parallel.

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: Audit and fix a site's SEO: technical, on-page, Core Web Vitals, structured data, E-E-A-T content, and AI-search (GEO) readiness — evidence-backed findings, then real fixes in the codebase.

plugins.name: seo-de
plugins.description: SEO-Audit und -Fixes auf Deutsch: technisch, On-Page, Core Web Vitals, strukturierte Daten, E-E-A-T und KI-Suche (GEO) — plus DACH-Spezifika wie Impressumspflicht, Umlaut-URLs und hreflang für DE/AT/CH.

plugins.name: telegramm
plugins.description: Extreme output compression for all Claude text including sub-agent returns — telegram style, symbols, result first, hard line budget. Saves reading time and tokens by omitting before writing, not by foreign-language compression.

plugins.name: wrapup
plugins.description: Memory across sessions: save a compact digest locally at session end, pull it back selectively at the start instead of rebuilding context. Optional Notion mirror (official API) for search and phone access.

plugins.name: deepfetch
plugins.description: Five-tier fetch escalation (direct, public-route, TLS impersonation, real browser, and — uniquely — the user's own browser cookies) for pages a plain fetch can't reach. Stops honestly at real login/paywall/captcha walls instead of faking success.
